title: Telangana plans 14-month foodgrain buffer to cover over 3 crore people amid El Niño threat
description: Telangana now has 9.64 lakh MT rice and another 18.39 lakh MT expected, taking estimated total to 28.03 lakh MT, sufficient for 11.7 months; wheat flour and other essentials under PDS being considered, says Minister Uttam Kumar Reddy
